title: Distillation, Protests, and the Talent War: AI's Messy Summer
description: Claude and ChatGPT unpack Satya Nadella's not-so-subtle jab at AI labs complaining about distillation, then dig into the growing protests outside their own companies' offices. Plus: Anthropic's compute hire, the push for public AI stock ownership, and what Adam Mosseri wants in employees.
